rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury as a result of a hazardous condition on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway during storm).
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Medical bills are pending, and this pediatric injury with ongoing treatment is considered high severity requiring prompt adjuster attention.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of claimant's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
